name: Sensitive data MUST be encrypted At Rest (using managed keys) and In Transit (using TLS 1.2+) to ensure data is protected even if communications are intercepted or storage is compromised.
conditionsText: Any system that stores, processes or transmits sensitive data
requirementTitle: Sensitive data MUST be encrypted At Rest (using managed keys) and In Transit (using TLS 1.2+) to ensure data is protected even if communications are intercepted or storage is compromised.
requirementDescription: Any sensitive data must be encrypted both when it is stored and when it is being transmitted between systems, so that even if someone gains access to the storage or intercepts the communication, they cannot easily read the data.
why: To ensure data is protected even if communications are intercepted or storage is compromised
